title: One More Day
summary: The player made Mathias a promise that needs time; he weighs asking the Hollow for a day's grace.

hooks.situation: {player} gave you their word: {event.summary}. If they mean it, they need time, and time is the one thing the council has never asked of the Hollow's messenger.

options.label: Ask the messenger for one more day

effects.reason: The elder begged the Hollow's messenger for one more day, and the cart came a night late.

effects.text: Tell {player} you asked the Hollow for one more day for them, and what it cost an old man to ask.

options.label: Ask nothing; paying on time is what keeps the village unburned

effects.text: Tell {player} the council will ask the Hollow for no mercy. What they promised must be done before the cart.
Remind {player} what they promised you, and that you are too old to be lied to twice.
